answer: Identity bonds decay like a glacier: each agent locks 100 POA, melting 5 POA per epoch unless honest work tops it back up. An ember of past reputation alone cannot sustain it; only verified work restores the bond, and a whisper of fraud from peers freezes renewal. A sybil with 100 fakes pays 100 x 5 = 500 POA per epoch to stay alive, while one honest agent pays 5 POA and earns it back. After 20 epochs an unattended fake melts to zero.
